items.label: Cozonac

criteria.C2: pass: historic dictionaries plus a current national-TV contest independently support easy-band familiarity
criteria.C3: fail on legibility despite passing the numeric/direct-neighbor floor: 23 incoming neighbors exist, but defining recipe and holiday approaches receive contradictory or unavailable feedback
criteria.C4: minimum pass only: flour, dessert and fruit are within one hop and several other obvious guesses are warm; the minimum does not cure the cold defining walnut path
criteria.C5: pass: the isolated noun has a dominant food sense; a fixed argot expression is not a competing standalone referent
criteria.C6: pass: salience 0.9737 exceeds the easy threshold

items.refute_first: The strongest promotion case is substantial: flour ranks 2/Fierbinte, dessert 4/Fierbinte, fruit 17/Fierbinte, sugar 25/Cald and egg 37/Cald, while the target is famous and unambiguous. That proves an obvious opener exists. It does not prove a coherent easy round. Walnut is a defining, source-backed cozonac filling but the accepted Nucă projection is rank 504/Rece; butter is rank 503/Rece. Meanwhile generic Fruct is rank 17/Fierbinte. The target description foregrounds walnut and the two major holidays, yet Crăciun and Paște are unresolved inputs. For an easy target, this rejects a normal player model of the dish after rewarding a generic category route. The objection is about current feedback, not target obscurity or the validity of the new flour edge.
items.factual_anchor: DEX defines the dish from sweet leavened dough and longstanding sources attest it across generations. PRO TV's five-generation recipe uses walnut and cocoa and explicitly ties it to Easter and Christmas; the 2025 La Măruță cozonac contest supplies an independent current general-audience signal.

items.label: Clătite

criteria.C2: pass: a historical dictionary record and independent 2022/2024/2025 national-media use support easy-band familiarity
criteria.C3: fail on whole-neighborhood legibility despite nine recognizable direct predecessors: a common filling alternative receives the coldest band next to an equivalent-use hot filling
criteria.C4: minimum pass only: flour, dessert, egg and dulceață are one hop/Fierbinte and milk is two hops/Cald; the minimum does not excuse the gem/dulceață contradiction
criteria.C5: pass: standalone Clătite under gastronomie dominantly names the dish; the participial/adjectival form of a clăti requires syntactic context
criteria.C6: pass: salience 0.7951 exceeds the easy threshold

items.refute_first: This is the closer case: flour ranks 2, dessert 3, egg 5 and dulceață 7, all Fierbinte, with milk rank 40/Cald. Those are several excellent openers and formally satisfy C4. The remaining contradiction is still material at easy difficulty. Romanian culinary sources present gem and dulceață as ordinary alternative clătite fillings; DEX defines gem as a fruit-and-sugar preserve. Yet Dulceață is one hop/Fierbinte while the accepted Gem projection is six hops/rank 1699/Inghetat; butter and honey are likewise six hops/Inghetat. The service therefore gives a confident, severely misleading score for a conventional filling rather than merely lacking an obscure term. Familiarity and four good openers do not make that whole-player path coherent. A future repair should preserve gem as a distinct guess and improve association feedback, not turn it into an exact Dulceață answer.
items.factual_anchor: DLRLC defines clătită as a thin cooked preparation with jam, cheese or vegetables. AGERPRES lists the common flour/egg/milk batter and both sweet and savory fillings. PRO TV's 2025 broadcast demonstrates savory cheese filling and a jam-filled dessert variant, while an older Romanian clătite business profile lists both dulceață and gem fillings in the same menu context.

overall.conclusion: Both raw candidates are factually sound, familiar and unambiguous, but neither should stage on the bound V77 graph. Each satisfies C4's explicit at-least-one-warm-opener minimum. The independent drop rests on severe contradictory feedback for defining ordinary guesses at usor difficulty, which fails whole-neighborhood legibility and the rubric's broader fairness purpose.
overall.limits: Independent agent review, not a human Romanian playtest. No candidate, graph, projection, source or fixture file was changed. A later graph/projection change requires fresh bound probes and review.
